components.name: ArchiveLowerThird
components.when_to_use: naming a person or a unit while the shot keeps running — the name on a white plate, the role on the tan bar welded under it
components.when_not_to_use: dating or sourcing the footage rather than naming somebody in it (ArchiveCaption); a section break that stops the narration (ArchiveChapterTitle); the words the person said (ArchiveQuoteCard)

title.description: the name, as it should read on the plate

components.name: ArchiveCaption
components.when_to_use: dating and sourcing the footage itself, as a ruled note pinned to the film ('Military parade for Afghan Independence Day, August 1966')
components.when_not_to_use: naming a person on screen (ArchiveLowerThird); a figure (ArchiveCounter); a sentence the video is asserting rather than a note about the picture (ArchiveChapterTitle)

text.description: what the shot is, where and when — one line, in the language of the video

label.description: reel, fond or archive mark on a tan tab ahead of the text

components.name: ArchiveChapterTitle
components.when_to_use: a full-screen act break: the tan kicker bar naming the part, the title on the plate under it
components.when_not_to_use: a name plate over continuing narration (ArchiveLowerThird); a caption about the footage (ArchiveCaption); the video's opening title (KineticTitle)

components.name: ArchiveQuoteCard
components.when_to_use: testimony — a line somebody actually said or wrote, set on the plate with the speaker on a tan strip under it
components.when_not_to_use: the video's own assertion rather than a quotation (ArchiveChapterTitle); naming a person who is not being quoted (ArchiveLowerThird); a caption about the footage (ArchiveCaption)

quote.description: the words, without surrounding quotation marks — the plate is the quotation

context.description: rank, role or date, under a hairline

components.name: ArchiveCounter
components.when_to_use: one figure worth dwelling on, counted up in typewriter mono on the plate under a tan label strip
components.when_not_to_use: three or more values being compared (ArchiveBarGraph); a quantity changing over an ordered sequence (ArchiveLineChart); a figure that is really a date or a source note (ArchiveCaption)

label.description: what the figure counts, on the tan strip

components.name: ArchiveBarGraph
components.when_to_use: two to six named quantities of the same kind compared as columns on the pack's ruled card
components.when_not_to_use: one figure (ArchiveCounter); the same quantity moving across an ordered sequence (ArchiveLineChart); dated events (Timeline)

title.description: what is being compared, on the tan header band

highlight_index.description: index of the one column that keeps full ink; the rest go muted

source.description: credit line along the bottom of the card

components.name: ArchiveLineChart
components.when_to_use: a quantity changing across an ordered sequence — production by year, losses by month — for up to three series, each named at the end of its own line
components.when_not_to_use: values at one moment (ArchiveBarGraph); a single figure (ArchiveCounter); events rather than measurements (Timeline)

x.description: a label plotted at equal spacing ('1941', 'Q3'), not a date

y_label.description: the unit, tracked out above the plot

source.description: credit line along the bottom of the card
